title: PAR-144 slice 2: explicit layout ownership and reciprocal graph validation

localScope.worktreeState: The worktree was already dirty from broader implementation. No unrelated edits were reverted and no commit was created.
implementation: Pending block records distinguish ordinary blocks from paper-layout owners while retaining the exact associated layout handle.
Successful LAYOUT writes retain their output handle, name, parent dictionary, and associated BLOCK_RECORD handle; successful ACAD_LAYOUT dictionary writes retain exact child names and handles.

Before BLOCK_CONTROL publication, validate unique layout identities, one-to-one reciprocal owner links, NOD/ACAD_LAYOUT reachability, and exact dictionary name/handle closure. Fixed Model/Paper owners and layout-linked user block records are supported by the validator.
The emitted association ledgers participate in bounded object-frame and compound-write rollback.
localScope.limits: This is still partial multi-layout output. Active/current-layout identity and compound/viewport owner coverage are incomplete; no general support claim is promoted.

contract.authority: Open Design Alliance Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
contract.disposition: The BLOCK_RECORD-to-LAYOUT hard pointer and LAYOUT-to-paperspace-BLOCK_RECORD soft pointer are validated reciprocally. R13-R14 entity mode and R2000+ owner-list formats were not changed in this slice.

coverage: Independent emitted handle-token checks at AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, AC1027, and AC1032.

Generated whole-file AC1015 and AC1024 writes include fixed Layout1 plus *Paper_Space7 and *Paper_Space19 with distinct LINE sentinels; the LAYOUT objects and dictionary entries are deliberately ordered differently from owner definition order.
The reader confirms exact LAYOUT and BLOCK_RECORD identities, dictionary reachability, and each marker in its associated owner block.
A nonreciprocal LAYOUT-to-BLOCK_RECORD link is refused without replacing a preexisting destination; a corrected write and reread succeeds using the same dwgRW façade.

status.nextAction: Expand exact owner routing to VIEWPORT and INSERT/ATTRIB/SEQEND across multiple paper layouts; then add remaining malformed dictionary/duplicate-owner controls and the narrow version matrix for touched writer branches.
status.commitReason: Existing unrelated dirty edits overlap the implementation files; no broad staging or commit was made.
